mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_message(title, content, type, target_type, target_ids, status, created_by) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetIds}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_message SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_ids = #{targetIds} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_message SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_message_read r WHERE r.message_id = m.id) AS readCount FROM admin_message m WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_message_read r WHERE r.message_id = m.id) AS readCount FROM admin_message m
ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_message_read r WHERE r.message_id = m.id) AS readCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_message_read r2 WHERE r2.message_id = m.id AND r2.user_id = #{userId}) AS isRead FROM admin_message m WHERE m.status = 'published' AND (m.target_type = 'all' OR FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, m.target_ids) > 0) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO admin_message_read(message_id, user_id) VALUES(#{messageId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_message_read WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT message_id FROM admin_message_read WHERE user_id = #{userId}
